newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's 1,065-day UDI bonds real return 7.15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's 1,065-day UDI bonds real return 7.15 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 1,065-day UDI bonds were assigned at a price of 96.98520 UDIs and a real return of 7.15 percent at the primary auction on Monday.
Two weeks ago the 1,078-day UDI bonds had a real return of 7.21 percent.
Demand this week was 1.182 billion UDIs compared to 250 million 1,065 UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico with a bid-to-cover ratio of 4.73.
The 1,751-day UDIs were assigned at a price of 95.47578 UDIs and a real return of 7.11 percent.
Two weeks ago the 1,764-day UDI bonds had a real return of 7.05 percent.
Demand this week was 1.306 billion UDIs compared to 250 million 1,751-day UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico with a bid-to-cover ratio of 5.22.
